description: This file defines WebSocket message structures, event types, and related methods for handling WebSocket communication in the Mattermost server, including event types, broadcast mechanisms, JSON serialization, and response handling.

classes.name: WebsocketBroadcast
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket broadcast message with filtering options and hooks.

classes.name: precomputedWebSocketEventJSON
classes.description: Stores precomputed JSON serialization of WebSocket event components for efficiency.

classes.name: webSocketEventJSON
classes.description: Serializable structure mirroring WebSocketEvent for JSON encoding.

classes.name: WebSocketEvent
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket event with methods for JSON serialization, copying, and management.

classes.name: WebSocketResponse
classes.description: Represents a response received through WebSocket, including status, data, and error information.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of WebsocketBroadcast.

methods.name: AddHook
methods.description: Adds a hook ID and arguments to the WebsocketBroadcast.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of precomputedWebSocketEventJSON.

methods.name: PrecomputeJSON
methods.description: Precomputes and stores JSON serialization for WebSocketEvent components.

methods.name: RemovePrecomputedJSON
methods.description: Removes precomputed JSON from WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: WithoutBroadcastHooks
methods.description: Returns a copy of WebSocketEvent without broadcast hooks and their arguments.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the WebSocketEvent data.

methods.name: NewWebSocketEvent
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocketEvent with specified parameters.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Returns the data map of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: GetBroadcast
methods.description: Returns the broadcast object of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: GetSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: SetEvent
methods.description: Sets the event type of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: SetData
methods.description: Sets the data map of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: SetBroadcast
methods.description: Sets the broadcast object of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: SetSequence
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocketEvent has a valid event type.

methods.name: EventType
methods.description: Returns the event type of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the WebSocketEvent to JSON, using precomputed data if available.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes the WebSocketEvent into a JSON encoder.

methods.name: precomputedJSONBuf
methods.description: Returns the precomputed JSON bytes of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: WebSocketEventFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the WebSocketResponse data.

methods.name: NewWebSocketResponse
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocketResponse with specified status, sequence reply, and data.

methods.name: NewWebSocketError
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocketResponse representing an error.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocketResponse has a valid status.

methods.name: EventType
methods.description: Returns the event type of the WebSocketResponse.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the WebSocketResponse to JSON.

methods.name: WebSocketResponseFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a WebSocketResponse.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Marks the WebSocketEvent as rejected.

methods.name: IsRejected
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocketEvent has been rejected.
